artworks.title: Voici les français! ... je fille ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing on a flat surface. The man on the left has a curved posture, exaggerated facial features, and tied-back hair. He wears a long-sleeved garment with a pattern, holds a fan-like object, and wears simple shoes. The man on the right has crossed arms, exaggerated facial features, and wears a pointed hat and a robe that covers his body. In the background, there are lightly sketched ships with visible sails on the water. The scene is drawn in a monochromatic style and framed within a border.

artworks.title: Viens donc ..., mon ami, je ne trouve pas ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts an exhibition scene from 1859. It shows several individuals, mostly men and one woman, in period clothing. The men wear long coats and top hats, with one man appearing to read a text. The woman wears a shawl over her head. In the background, a large framed painting or panel features two figures, one with wild hair and a surprised expression. The setting includes frames and artwork, creating a busy exhibition space. The image is in monochrome tones.

artworks.title: Ne craignez rien ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of men in formal attire engaged in conversation. The men are depicted in suits and top hats, conversing animatedly. The background is filled with additional figures, creating a bustling crowd. The image includes a caption in French that likely provides context to the scene, similar to 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: J'ai acheté ... un tonneau de vin ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five men standing together in conversation. They are facing each other and appear engaged. They all have distinct facial features, wearing top hats, long overcoats, waistcoats, and cravats. The setting seems to be indoors, with a table and other seated people in the background.

artworks.title: Le coin des politiques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Four men are seated closely together at a table, shown from the waist up. They are leaning forward in a relaxed manner, each holding a pipe from which smoke is rising. The man on the far left has a round face, prominent facial features, and a thick beard; his hair is short and tousled. The second man, positioned slightly behind the first, has a leaner face with a pointed nose and his hair slicked back. The third man, with sharp facial features and curly hair, peeks over the shoulders of the others with a curious expression. The last man on the far right wears spectacles, giving him an academic air, with slightly disheveled hair and a contemplative expression. They are dressed in dark suits and cravats. On the table in front of them are large mugs and a pitcher. The background is busy with faint outlines of other individuals and smoke indicative of a lively indoor setting.

artworks.title: Une visite du jour de l'an
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals climbing a staircase. A man carrying a child, who is looking to the side, is followed by two other children. The man wears a long, dark coat and a rounded hat, while the children wear dark clothing and hats. The background shows a staircase with a railing, suggesting an indoor setting. The wall behind them has a textured appearance, hinting at the continuation of the stairs downwards.

artworks.title: Un renseignement
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in an outdoor setting. One figure is carrying a large bundle of firewood on their back and pointing in a specific direction, while the other figure is dressed in a long coat and hat and is listening. Both figures are drawn in a cartoonish style with exaggerated facial features and expressions. The ground has a textured surface and there are no additional background details. Text at the bottom of the image provides context. The overall tone of the drawing is lighthearted.

artworks.title: Ou allez-vous  donc?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The sketch shows 2 men. The man in the foreground is walking with a rifle slung over his shoulder. He wears a hat and a coat, depicted with exaggerated facial features. Next to him is a dog sniffing the ground. The man in the background stands in a dynamic pose, gesturing with one hand in the air and holding a stick or tool in the other. He is thinner with exaggerated facial features and unkempt hair. The setting is a barren, rocky landscape, with no significant vegetation or landmarks. The image has a humorous tone, likely intended as a caricature or satirical depiction.

artworks.title: Pour la septième fois voulez-vous me rendre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a theater. In the foreground, two individuals are seated closely and engaged in a discussion. One figure has a flustered expression and looks up at the other figure, who leans over them wearing a top hat and an intense expression. In the background, there is a blurred crowd of onlookers seated in rows. The drawing is in black and white with cross-hatched shading.

artworks.title: Tout n'est pas rose dans l'agriculture ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene featuring two figures and a wheelbarrow. The drawing depicts an expressive and exaggerated style common in caricatures. On the left, there is a figure with a round face wearing a large hat and dress. To the right, another figure with an elongated face is engaged in pushing a wheelbarrow piled with a mound. The background includes stylized clouds and trees. The figures indicate a humorous or satirical tone.

artworks.title: Le retour est souvent difficile
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of two individuals with exaggerated features. The person on the left is leaning toward the right, supported by the figure beside them. They wear formal clothing and a tall top hat. The person on the right has a curved back and older-looking face, wearing a soft cap and less formal attire. They hold a basket or similar object. The background includes a lightly sketched landscape with a large moon or sun in the sky, a walking figure, and some indistinct structures or trees.

artworks.title: En v'la un qu'est un drole de corps ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals in a countryside setting. Two figures in the foreground are conversing while pointing towards the background where an artist is painting outdoors. The characters are dressed in 19th-century rural clothing and the landscape features hills and trees. The drawing uses lines and hatching for depth and a slight satirical tone is present in the characters' exaggerated features and expressions.

artworks.title: Les crétins! ... On leur peint un tableau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of people looking at art in a gallery. Multiple individuals are standing in front of a large, framed painting that depicts religious or mythological figures. The people exhibit various expressions as they observe the artwork. Their attire reflects a historical period with formal clothing such as coats and hats. The background includes details like walls and frames, indicating an art gallery or exhibition space. The drawing features heavy lines and shading and is created in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: J'ai donc tué un perdreau!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing on a rough or grassy landscape. The man on the left is standing upright, looking upward with a slightly amused expression. The man on the right is hunched over, examining a small object in his hands. The man on the left is holding a pitchfork, while the man on the right has a rifle leaning against a large rock beside him.

artworks.title: Des huitres a vingt-cinq sous la douzaine ... !
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals interacting. On the left, a man is leaning back with his hands raised in front of him. He has round glasses and a full beard, and his mouth is open. He wears a top hat, a coat, and a scarf. On the right, an elderly woman is seated, leaning slightly forward with her hands raised. She wears a bonnet and a shawl. The woman appears to be sitting on a large cushion placed on a wooden table or bench. The background is lightly sketched, with a shaded area on the woman's side suggesting a wall or surface.

artworks.title: Mon cher Holsteinois, votez je vous en prie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals engaged in an exchange related to voting. The central figure holds a box labeled "URNE" and extends it towards another figure. A third figure is seated, bound with chains. The scene is rendered in black and white with exaggerated features, typical of 19th-century political cartoons. The drawing conveys a satirical tone, likely critiquing political or social issues of the time.

artworks.title: Hier le fusil a aiguille, eux demain ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures wearing academic robes and tall hats approaching a building labeled "Congrès Universel des Médecins." The drawing depicts several robed figures with exaggerated features, meticulously sketched in black and white. Each figure seems to be either listening or taking notes as they make their way towards a formal building, suggested by the columns and the sign above. The style is satirical, capturing a sense of humor in the way the characters are portrayed with elongated noses and serious expressions. The title, "Hier le fusil à aiguille, eux demain: gagnerons-nous au change?", is written below the drawing.

artworks.title: Turgot -- Eh bien mon pauvre condé ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing and facing each other. The man on the left has wavy hair styled in an 18th-century fashion and holds a scroll that says "A Liberté". He is wearing a long coat, tights, and shoes with buckles. The man on the right has long curly hair flowing from underneath a large hat with feathers. He is dressed in a detailed coat and breeches and appears to be holding a walking stick.

artworks.title: En ballon captif
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two individuals in a basket suspended from a tethered balloon. The drawing features a hot air balloon basket with two figures on board, each looking through telescopes pointed in different directions. The balloon takes up the full scene vertically, with detailed lines representing the basket structure, while the fabric looms above. The figures are depicted in lines and shading, wearing mid-19th-century attire with top hats. The environment is minimal, emphasizing the details of the basket and figures.

artworks.title: Comment Madame Prudhomme ... En vivandière ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing facing each other. On the left, a woman with her hands on her hips, wearing a dark top, a lighter apron, a voluminous skirt, and shoes. She has her hair up, possibly adorned with a hat or hairpiece with a ribbon. On the right, a man with his hands clasped in front of him, wearing a long, patterned robe. The room has a decorative rug on the floor and an upholstered furniture piece in the background against a plain wall.

artworks.title: La rentrée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of small, gnome-like figures approaching the entrance of a building labeled "PENSIONNAT INTERNATIONAL". The figures are depicted with exaggerated features and are marching in a line toward a large, imposing figure of a woman standing at the door. The woman is draped in classical attire, resembling a Grecian statue or an allegorical representation. The composition has a playful yet satirical tone, with the figures' comical appearance contrasted against the seriousness of the grand figure and setting. The use of line work and shading adds a dynamic quality to the scene, drawing attention to the contrast between the figures and the structured arch of the building entrance.

artworks.title: La perche
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals performing an acrobatic act on a pole. The upper figure is upside down holding onto the pole, while the lower figure is balancing at the base. The drawing features exaggerated facial expressions and body postures, with the addition of text "RUE DE POITIERS." The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: Et ils veulent rattraper le train!!!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage labeled "COMMISSION EXTRA PARLEMENTAIRE" chasing after a train labeled "PROGRÈS" in the background. The carriage is filled with figures. The text at the bottom adds to the scene. The drawing style is reminiscent of political and societal cartoons.

artworks.title: C'est pourtant pas pour ca ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with a slight turn to the side, arms crossed. Their short hair is mostly covered by a flat cap. They wear a loose shirt, pants, and a belt. The background shows a rough, uneven ground with debris and a crumbling stone structure.
